card.name: Weight-loss and obesity drug label text
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens (digits, drug-name pieces, small words like "of") inside text about obesity or weight-loss drugs such as CONTRAVE, phentermine/topiramate, diethylpropion and MYALEPT. The topic matters more than the exact word.
